node.statement: By def-stochastic and def-almost-idempotent, a row-stochastic matrix Q is equivalently the row-stochastic map Q:l_inf^n->l_inf^n used by lem-routef-f0-assembly, a stochastic idempotent is row-stochastic E with E^2=E, and the inf->inf and infinity->infinity symbols denote the same induced operator norm; independent of n means n-free.
